data.description:
The two screens that close chain link 6, "freelancer sees it paid". Dashboard: the freelancer's invoices and contracts with status. Invoice detail: full status, amounts, due date, and the Stripe-hosted links (hosted_invoice_url, invoice_pdf) surfaced for the freelancer to open or copy. Built to AS-30's wireframes and states ledgers, consuming the AS-29 tokens.

IMPLEMENTS: docs/engineering/00-d1-v1-milestone-plan.md section 3 rows C-37 (dashboard / list) and C-38 (invoice detail and status); section 4.3 screens 3 and 5 of 7.

DECISION CONTEXT. Merged as one task with a written justification (milestone plan section 8.2): one reviewable claim — "the freelancer can see what they have sent and whether it is paid" — at around 450 projected lines. Status comes from the invoice mirror the webhook task syncs; these screens read our own records and never call Stripe live. The hosted links are SURFACED, NOT REBUILT: our own invoice PDF (row C-30) and our own payment page (row C-34) are OUT under Rule 2, because Stripe's are the product here and building parallel implementations is exactly what Rule 2 forbids — the spike measured our own invoice PDF renderer at 107 lines and 0.194 ms and still found it unnecessary.

VERIFICATION: states ledger exercised — no invoices yet, loading, populated, stale/unsynced, error; status transitions render correctly from fixture mirror records; renders at 375px before desktop; tokens only, no magic values.

NOT IN THIS TASK: invoice creation (the invoice-UI task); contract screens (the contract-UI task); reminder configuration or a manual re-send control (rows C-39 and C-40, OUT — Rule 1; Stripe's own reminder cadences ride on the connected account at zero cost to us and are configured by the freelancer in their own Stripe Dashboard); analytics or reporting (row C-56, OUT); an account-settings screen (row C-41, OUT).

data.body: Plan written (Owen on Opus under the Fable fallback; tick watcher:79108 loop tick 9): .lattice/plans/task_01M1D34P63WC2P2CYJ3N65W5H1.md. Five decisions: (1) a row reaches its detail screen through a GET form with a hidden id and a UUID-shape redirector (GET /invoices/view, GET /contracts/view -> 303), never an href interpolation — P2a has no exception and AS-47 already refused an id in an href; (2) GET / is the Dashboard for every signed-in freelancer, ready or not — AS-70's interim 303 /connect-stripe is deleted, its six screens.test.js cases rewritten to a terminus of / at 200 with the gated note, and S2-RETURN-READY's 'Continue to Dashboard' control lands (AS-70's hand-off); (3) status from the mirror through one closed STATUS_BADGES table shared by list and detail — void/uncollectible/finalized-unsent render inside S5-DEFAULT-OPEN with their own badge (ledger gap for Jonah); (4) send from the detail page is POST /invoices/send with a hidden id calling the same lifecycle.send, failure -> ?error=send presence flag layered on the unchanged state; (5) the two hosted Stripe links render as escaped text to open or copy, not anchors (P2a; the redirector-to-external-URL alternative is an open-redirect surface — rejected; validated-origin anchor named as the follow-up with its trigger). Partitions 3+1+1+1+1=7 and 5+1+1+1+2=10; 28 ACs, 14 recipes, 27 named cases in a new test/read-screens.test.js. Baseline taken on master 61d8b3f: 451/433/0/18, 'Image asc-plan-as48-owen-test Built', torn down, leak check clean — and my asc-plan-as49 leftovers (two images via compose down, the stripe-mock container by name since compose no longer claimed it) are gone; other lanes' images untouched. Predicted vs today's master 478/460/0/18; at review after AS-47 (+10) and AS-49 (+7, skipped 19) ≈ 495/476/0/19. Merge order AS-47 -> AS-49 -> AS-48; seams: routes/contracts.js registration order (view before :id), contract-detail.ejs nav anchor, every §0.2 literal (ALL_ROUTES +4, VIEWS +2, harness +1, source +5, money row +2, expectFiles 8/7), and AS-49's e2e-loop AC-2 which pins the interim 303 /connect-stripe at a3619a8 lines 178-185 — AS-48 amends it at rebase. Split line 1,500 changed lines at Unit A (see it) / Unit B (send from detail = AS-48b). Complexity medium. Marcus implements (free once AS-47's review is Ruben's; his AS-47 visual.mjs is the §5 recipe), Priya reviews (after AS-49's), Ruben as the fallback if the two reviews collide. Branch feat/AS-48-read-views linked, worktree .worktrees/AS-48 added from 61d8b3f. Not run: lattice status (orchestrator moves to planned with --no-auto-review).

Implementation stage — Marcus on Opus under the Fable fallback (tick watcher:79108 loop tick 10). Branch feat/AS-48-read-views, worktree .worktrees/AS-48, base master 61d8b3f (AS-46 in; AS-47/AS-49 not in, so no rebase this stage). Tip d5c6833 (two commits: 4a75271 code+tests, d5c6833 README). Working tree clean (git diff --exit-code) after every recipe; every mutation ran on a git-archive extract under /tmp, never in the worktree.

FINDINGS AND DEVIATIONS FIRST

1. SPLIT LINE CROSSED, AND I CROSSED IT THE WRONG WAY. Plan §6 says measure at "Unit A complete and green" and stop there if over 1,500. I built Unit B (POST /invoices/send, canSend/sendLabel/showSetupNote, the sendFailed overlay, cases 15–17) inline before measuring — tunnel vision, my named failure mode. Measured at commit 4a75271: 2,265 changed lines (2,144 + 121); Unit B is roughly 200 of them, so Unit A alone is ~2,050 and the trigger fires either way. I did NOT rip Unit B out: it is green, tested and falsified (F6), and removing it would not bring the branch under the line while leaving the DRAFT/unsent-open states with the "honest hole" copy the plan wrote only for the split case. Recorded for the CTO's ruling: review as one unit, or have the reviewer scope Unit B as AS-48b's diff. No AS-48b filed by me (the plan says the split files it; I did not split).
2. §7 says 27 new cases in test/read-screens.test.js; the file carries 24 — cases 23 (screens.test.js, rewritten in place), 26 (the recounts) and 27 (e2e-loop, after AS-49) are not in it by the plan's own placement. Prediction adjusted before the run: 451 + 24 = 475.
3. §0.2 baselines were stale against the branch base: route-surface G1 22 not 21 (POST /clients, AS-65); dependency-policy source 54 not 52. Recounted from the code, not the table: routes 26 / G1b 25 / protected 20 / G15 26; source 59.
4. Two literals §0.2 missed entirely: test/contracts.test.js Y2 (contractRoutes' own stack list, ['POST /contracts'] → + 'GET /contracts/view') and test/health.test.js 'GET / answers a signed-in caller rather than 404ing' (asserted the AS-70 303; now 200 + S3-EMPTY-FIRSTRUN). Both found by run 1's red set.
5. §2 says test/invoice-screen.test.js is "not modified" — it carries two literals over VIEWS (TEMPLATE_LINKS 13 → 32; the state-id case's templates.length 3 → 5). Minimal literal edits only; case 20's Location-only assertion untouched as §0.2 asks.
6. §3.1's "six screens.test.js cases" live in two files: screens.test.js (2 terminus cases) and auth.test.js (H11's admitted control at :699 plus the two terminus cases). All five now end on / at 200 with the gated note; hop counts 2 → 1.
7. §2 says app.css gains .banner-success — it already existed (AS-70). No-op. Added instead, beyond the plan's list: .section-title (the h2s the wireframe draws as state__subtitle), .inline-form (a form standing in for a link — the View/Edit/Send controls), .link-list li + li, and .link-text with overflow-wrap: anywhere (§5 asked for exactly that).
8. F13's plan prediction (cases 20/21) cannot be reached over HTTP: the route never passes an invoice and a failure together, so the precedence falsifier lands in case 3's pure assertions (a paid row with failure set → NOTFOUND/SYSTEM). Observed exactly that.
9. §5 FINDING, the place the plan said to look hardest: at 375px the invoice table scrolls INSIDE .table-wrap (wrapper 16..359, clientWidth 341, scrollWidth 751 for four columns with the 57-char client name; 578 for the contracts table). The page never widens (documentElement.scrollWidth 375 in all 24 renders), which is the property §3.6 states — but Amount, Status and View sit entirely off the first screen with no visible affordance (scratchpad/agent-developer-marcus/AS-48/visual/S3-DEFAULT-POPULATED-*-375.png). Mechanism as designed (wireframe.css's nowrap cells + overflow-x auto); usability is a question for Jonah — §11 Q6: let the Client cell wrap, or stack rows at the 375 floor. Not changed here.
10. Boring choices recorded: the first-run invoice CTA renders only when stripeReady (case 4 wants zero /invoices/new hrefs when gated, and a primary control pointing at screen 4's refusal is the R-2 defect); an unready empty Dashboard therefore has the lede and the nav's finish-setup link and no CTA. The send-failed sentence on screen 5 is mine ("Something went wrong sending this invoice. Nothing was sent to the client — try again.") — the wireframe has none. sendLabel is "Finalize & send" while status is draft (including an attached-but-unfinalized row, which is accurate: the pipeline resumes from finalize) and "Send" for an open unsent row. lib/screens/connect-view.js keeps one stale comment line ("READY has NO control until the Dashboard exists") because §2 forbids editing it — reviewer's call whether to touch it.
11. Recipe F13 in the 6-wide batch had one extra red, stripe-client 'transport: times out' (requests.length 0: the 200 ms timeout fired before the listener's handler ran under six parallel suites). Re-run alone: exactly the predicted set. Classified as load, not a survivor and not a gap; noted so nobody chases it.
12. §8 F12 as written ("branch on a repository probe") is not constructible — no repository call can see another owner's row, which is the design. The mutant I ran does the one thing a route could do to make NOTOWNER differ from NOTFOUND: echo req.params.id in the title. Case 20's byte-equality caught it.

CARDINALITY, THEN RECEIPTS
- read-screens.test.js: 24 cases, 872 lines (cap 1,200). Ledger tables: screen 3 seven rows (3+1+1+1+1), screen 5 ten rows (5+1+1+1+2), transcribed by hand from §3/§5 on 2026-09-12 and compared by set equality to the view models' copies. Dispositions: S3-GATED 'layered — …', S5-DENIED-NOTOWNER 'rendered as S5-ERROR-NOTFOUND' (the AS-47 precedent).
- Literals moved (all recounted from the code and confirmed by the run): routes 26/25/20, G15 26; VIEWS 5; source 59 (+ dashboard-view.js, dates.js, invoice-detail-view.js, dashboard.ejs, invoice-detail.ejs); expectFiles 6; P4 templates 5; VIEW_START_TAGS 87+47+208+131+101 = 574 (instrument calibrated first: it reproduces master's 87/43/206, 13 and 146/115); harness 20; APP_CSS 189/152; money row +2 (both view models); P8 2; Y2 2; TEMPLATE_LINKS 32; the new-template link count 17.
- Predicted before run 1: 475/457/0/18. Run 1 (asc-impl-as48-1, Built): 475/452/5/18 — the two missed literals (finding 4) and three of my own assertions (EJS renders apostrophes as ' in two places; the guard's next carries the query string). Run 2 (asc-impl-as48-2): 475/457/0/18 'Image asc-impl-as48-2-test Built', exit 0, down 0, leak clean. Contract service (asc-impl-as48-contract, stripe-mock): 475/475/0/0 'Image asc-impl-as48-contract-contract Built', no case added (AC 26). ASC_SELFTEST_MUTATE=1 not re-run this stage — V1 is untouched and the reviewer runs it anyway.
- Logs: scratchpad/agent-developer-marcus/AS-48/run1-test.log, run2-test.log, recipe-<name>.log; runner recipe.cjs, batch.cjs; predictions in progress.md, written before each batch.

RECIPES §8 — 16 mutants, every one on an extract, assert-applied at the intended site (occurrence counts anchored to the enclosing construct; F9/F13 also assert the ORDER moved), every run Built, torn down, leak clean. Predicted → observed:
F1 form→href with the id: 5 → 5 (concept row P2a, the link walker in BOTH read-screens and invoice-screen, case 5, case 6's View count). F2 hosted URL as href: 4 → 4. F3 hostedInvoiceUrl null: 3 → 3 (cases 9, 10, 14; plan said 1). F3a literal Amount: 1 → 1 (money row). F4a pages.js swallows: 1 → 1 (case 8). F4b detail system→not-found: 1 → 1 (case 21). F5 stripeReady=true: 6 → 6 (cases 4, 7, both screens.test.js terminus cases, both auth.test.js terminus cases; plan said 3). F6 canSend unguarded: 2 → 2 (cases 3, 15). F7 /contracts/new anchor: 3 → 3 (concept VIEW_START_TAGS, both walkers). F8 UUID test dropped in both redirectors: 1 → 1 (case 18). F9 view after :id: 2 → 2 (cases 18, 19). F10 toLocaleString('de-DE'): 4 → 4 (case 25 + the three $1,200.00 sites). F10b MINOR_DIGITS 3: ≥6 → 11 (every price site across read-screens and invoice-screen). F11a/F11b one ledger row removed: 1 → 1 each (cardinality fires first). F12 id echoed: 1 → 1 (case 20). F13 paid before failure: 1 → 1 alone (finding 11). No survivors; three wider-than-plan sets (F1, F3, F5, F6) are extra readers of the same property, each named above.

§5 INSPECTION — done (scratchpad/agent-developer-marcus/AS-48/visual.mjs, project asc-as48-visual on 127.0.0.1:8360, 'Image asc-as48-visual-web Built', Chrome/152 headless over CDP, Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride 375×812 @2x, both colour schemes; PNGs and inspection.log beside it). Looked at, 24 renders = 12 states × 2 schemes: S3 EMPTY-FIRSTRUN gated and ready, DEFAULT-POPULATED ready and gated, ERROR-SYSTEM (contracts dropped in-container); S5 DEFAULT-DRAFT, DRAFT with ?error=send, DRAFT gated (setup sentence, no Send), DEFAULT-OPEN with two 175/158-char hosted URLs, DEFAULT-PAID, ERROR-NOTFOUND, ERROR-SYSTEM (invoice_line_items dropped). Measured: page scrollWidth 375 everywhere; .link-text 36..356 (w 320, ~5 lines, overflow-wrap anywhere) — the long URL wraps and never widens the page; badges, nav, controls and banners all within 16..359; light bg rgb(248,248,250)/dark rgb(18,21,25) from tokens. Not looked at: S3/S5-LOADING (unrenderable), the two DENIED-SIGNEDOUT 303s, the void/uncollectible/unsent badge variants (asserted in case 13, not captured), any desktop width. The table finding is item 9. Teardown: down -v --rmi local exit 0 left the detached `run -d web` container, its image, network and volume (compose does not claim run containers — Owen's AS-49 note); removed by name; leak check clean after.

HANDED FORWARD / WHAT REMAINS
- README § Obligations hands AS-127 the New-contract nav entry (screens 3/4/5/7) and the first-run contract CTA with the exact markup; §11's five deviations plus Q6 (item 9) are Jonah's.
- Rebase onto AS-47 and AS-49 at their merges (§10): recount every literal from the failing messages, add the Dashboard anchor to contract-detail.ejs, amend e2e-loop AC-2 (§7 case 27). Not this stage: neither is in master.
- Status unchanged (in_progress); the orchestrator moves it. Ready for review as one unit pending the CTO's ruling on item 1; reviewer should not read my scratchpad before forming their own results.

CTO RULING on the split (cto-owen, tick watcher:79108 loop tick 10): review AS-48 as ONE unit, Unit B included. Reasoning: the split line (plan §6, 1,500 changed lines) exists to bound the review; Marcus measured Unit A alone at ~2,050, so the trigger fires with or without Unit B and carving Unit B out to AS-48b would not bring the diff under the line — it would only add a rebase-and-recount cycle to a unit that is built, green, and falsified (16/16 recipes red, no survivors). AS-48b is therefore not filed. The reviewer may still recommend the carve-out if Unit B is where the findings land; that becomes an implementation-level rework, not a plan-level one. Recorded deviations stand as findings on the task: 24 cases not 27, stale §0.2 baselines recounted, literal edits to invoice-screen.test.js and auth.test.js the plan did not list, and Q6 (long client name pushes Amount/Status/View off the first 375px screen inside the scroll wrapper — Jonah's Q-list, not a defect). STAYS in_progress: merge order is AS-47 -> AS-49 -> AS-48, so the next stage on this branch is the rebase onto post-AS-47/AS-49 master (recounts, contract-detail.ejs anchor, e2e AC-2 pin) and then review — same shape as AS-47's wait on AS-46. Priya reviews (Ruben fallback), and must not read scratchpad/agent-developer-marcus/AS-48/ before forming her own findings.
